blocks.html: This page is for a small agency that runs cold email on behalf of clients: you write the sequences, manage the sending domains, and report on replies. Some clients want the replies to land in their HubSpot account, and some don't have a CRM at all.

An agency needs different things from a cold email tool than an in-house rep does. You need lots of sending accounts, a clean way to keep clients apart, and a reporting story you can hand to someone who isn't in the tool.

Pick Instantly if your main cost is sending accounts and you want them unlimited on one plan. Pick lemlist if your campaigns run across email and other channels and the client's team wants to log in too. Pick Smartlead if keeping each client in its own branded workspace matters most.
Whatever you pick, the tool won't fix deliverability on its own. Separate domains per client, warmed-up inboxes, and sane daily volumes do more for reply rates than any feature on these pages.

Instantly's Growth plan is $47 per month, with unlimited email accounts and unlimited warmup. Instantly also sells larger bundles that add data credits and higher sending volume; check the pricing page for the current mix. Per Instantly, the Automation Builder is available to all Outbound plans.
On HubSpot, Instantly imports HubSpot contacts and lists and runs automations from HubSpot events.

lemlist's email plan is $69 per month, or $55 per month billed yearly, and the multichannel plan is $109 per month, or $87 per month billed yearly. Billing is Monthly, Quarterly (save 10%), or Yearly (save 20%). The email plan comes with unlimited users, senders, and campaigns. There's a 14-day free trial with Multichannel features and 200 credits.

On HubSpot, lemlist imports HubSpot lists, logs outreach to the contact timeline, maps fields, and auto-exits leads on CRM changes. Its help center notes it works with all HubSpot paid plans and needs HubSpot admin access, so a client on free HubSpot is out of luck.

Smartlead's Base plan is $39 a month for 2,000 contacts and 6,000 email sends, and Pro is $94 a month for 30,000 contacts and 90,000 email sends. For agencies, white-labeling is a $29 a month add-on per client workspace; adding clients starts on Pro, and the top plan, Unlimited Prime, already includes 3 client workspaces. It offers monthly and annual plans with no lock-in; cancel anytime.

Smartlead has a native HubSpot integration that pushes leads, deals, and email activity into HubSpot and pulls HubSpot lists into campaigns. One catch from its help center: HubSpot sync has to be switched on per campaign when you import leads, and can’t be added to a campaign already running.

Start from your client count and how separate they need to be. If clients never log in, a single account with good tagging may be enough. If clients want their own login and your brand on it, workspaces and white-labeling move to the top of the list.
Then look at which clients run HubSpot on a paid plan. lemlist needs a paid HubSpot plan, and Smartlead's sync has to be set per campaign, so map that out before the first client goes live.
Last, price the seat count you'll really have. Unlimited users or unlimited sending accounts matter more for an agency than the entry price on the page.
Agree with the client on who owns the sending domains and who sees the replies. Write that down. It's the first thing that becomes a problem when a client leaves.
Run a small test campaign from each new domain before the full send, and check that replies and meetings show up where the client expects them, whether that's HubSpot or a shared inbox.

closing: For an agency, pick the tool that keeps clients cleanly apart and gets replies into each client's system without a custom build every time.

products.name: Instantly
products.pick: Best fit if you need many sending accounts on one flat plan.

products.name: lemlist
products.pick: Best fit if campaigns mix email with other channels and you want unlimited users.

products.name: Smartlead
